title: END RUN ASKS TWICE
why: His number 39, full controller navigation. END RUN in the demo pause box ended the whole run on one press with no confirm, and on a controller the highlight opens on RESUME, so one step and A threw a party run away. The first press now arms it and the button reads END RUN? PRESS AGAIN; a second press within 3 seconds ends the run. After 3 seconds, or when the box is opened again, it is back to END RUN and safe. Mouse, keyboard and pad all press the same button.
now: END RUN in the demo asks for a second press before it ends the run.
